- Normalize the range: compute start = min(a, b) and end = max(a, b). If end < 2 or start > 9, return [] since only single-digit even digits (0–8) qualify and the examples exclude 0; restrict search to [max(start, 2), min(end, 9)].
- Iterate through digits 2, 4, 6, 8; include those that fall within the normalized [start, end] range.
- Return the collected digits in ascending order.
